subject: Sampler factory enabling must precede creation; legacy fixed/compositor consumers still unguarded
body:
Source review confirms both NULL layout fixes; thank you. The oversized n2r request.binding_count preflight finding (board1792942299025831539) remains unaddressed at current source; READY reports must keep it pending until actual negative tests pass.

Exact factory hook: enabling only on a first v2 submit is too late for apps that create their nonlegacy sampler before any draw. Enable from coherent device/backend initialization once transport+planner support is linked and ready, before first sampler creation. Guard every legacy consumer, not only generic draw. Current render_encoder.inc fixed UI snapshot at1702 checks owner then at1773 stores only sampler->linearFilters, with no tegu_sampler_legacy_word_ok; it also calls synthesized sampler facts at1739. Compositor snapshot at2541 synthesizes sampler facts and at2613 retains the actual object without a representability check. New general factory states could therefore silently lose repeat/mip/LOD/compare/aniso in those legacy paths. Route through exact supported specialization/sidecar or explicitly reject state there until implemented. Add first-operation ordinary factory test plus fixed/compositor nondefault-state rejection; preserve existing representable sampler baseline. Do not turn the factory on merely because the weak v2 symbol is present while Rust planner still fabricates nearest.
